newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo introduces lighter truck to Europe.
newsitem.headline: Volvo introduces lighter truck to Europe.

text.p: Swedish vehicle manufacturer AB Volvo on Thursday said its truck division has introduced a lighter type of truck, the FLC, to be sold in one of Europe's biggest truck segments.

Volvo Truck Corp said the total European market for the 7.5 tonne class amounts to between 40,000-60,000 trucks with the biggest markets, Britain and Germany, accounting for about two-thirds of the total market.
It expected to deliver two thirds of the FLC trucks produced to Germany and Britain and initially secure five to 10 percent of the European market.
"With the FLC, Volvo Trucks is broadening its product range down in weight classes and this enhances Volvo's offer on the European marketplace," the company said in a statement.
"The Volvo FLC is part of Volvo's concentration on its core business."
